The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]] used a '''''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was stolen by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who killed Mentir during his escape from [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].
